caption: The video captures a bathroom interior centered on a wall-mounted rectangular mirror, where a person with long brown hair, glasses, and an olive-green jacket holds a smartphone horizontally at eye level, filming their reflection. The mirror shows a plain wall with a towel bar and a doorway, while framed fern prints and a waffle-textured towel hang on the surrounding walls. Throughout the excerpt the framing gradually widens, revealing the mirror's top and bottom borders and more of the textured wall. The person's reflection stays roughly centered and similarly sized relative to the mirror, with only small hand, phone, and head adjustments. The reflected towel bar, doorway, and towel stay fixed, as do the prints, shifting in apparent position only as the framing widens.
